name: Smolabot Trade Economics Check
description: POST /check answers one question with arithmetic only: does a proposed long (buy) trade still clear after fees, spread, slippage and an optional profit buffer? No predictions, no market data, no execution. Costs 1 prepaid credit per successful check; every failure costs 0. Get an API key (10 free checks) at https://smolabot.arison8.com. The same check is available to MCP clients as the tool trade_check at https://smolabot.arison8.com/mcp (same key, same Authorization header). Calculation model v1-long-only: the same model_version and the same input always produce the same output.
